crossRefs.note: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish…

translations.web: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,
translations.bsb: Now when men began to multiply on the face of the earth and daughters were born to them,
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the ground, and daughters were born unto them,
